versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the photo-editor skill for generating AI-powered multi-page image carousels using advanced models like Nano Banana, Nano Banana-2, Imagen-2, and more.
- Enables users to create editable photo posters from simple text prompts with customizable sizes and design styles.
- Supports generating assets with editable text elements (headline, content, footer) and advanced layout templates.
- Integration with OneKey Agent Gateway via a required access key for secure API access.
- Provides multiple links for online console, gallery, workspace, and marketplace to facilitate user workflow.
- Includes detailed API usage instructions, parameter configuration, and quick-start examples.
